BiblicalUsage: Giach is a place near Gibeon in Benjamin, named in the account of Joab and Abishai pursuing Abner. It stands in 2 Samuel 2:24, on the way to the wilderness of Gibeon.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Giach matters because God's story happened in real places, and Giach is one of them.
RelatedEvents: David Becomes King; David's War with the House of Saul
